title: NearMe
description: a simple Mod sending a notification to your phone or desktop, when a player is near you
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aca0c260b4eb59c3d420129e537b8114d39eb6ee_0.webp)

> **NearMe** sends a push notification to your phone the moment another player gets close — works on any server, no server-side setup needed.

## WARNING
> Using this mod on public servers may be considered cheating and could result in a mute, ban, or other punishment. Always check the rules of a server before using NearMe. **Use at your own risk.**

For questions or bug reports, DM me on Discord: **@simsonimson**



---

# 📲 Setup Guide

## Step 1 — Install ntfy.sh on your device

NearMe uses [ntfy.sh](https://ntfy.sh) to deliver notifications. Download the app for your platform:

[![Android](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7ea35e613302c8e7878d1713a1969e7445187d6.png)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.heckel.ntfy&hl)
[![iOS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0e12c920fa11e4aaa780a35580b1388b06a5ebf.png)](https://apps.apple.com/app/ntfy/id1625396347)
[![Windows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9040ea256cc8108c0293726c09cbbf06ac2133e7.png)](https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy)

---

## Step 2 — Create a topic

Open the app and tap the **+** button in the bottom-right corner.

![PlusImage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5812fb86b192c0110ee3bf4d502b1221205b1599_0.webp)

Enter a topic name that is **hard to guess** — this acts like a private channel. Anyone who knows your topic name can receive your notifications, so treat it like a password.

![Topicname](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5550ec34f9e775de82a4d0f0f1738ea3b548aa51_0.webp)

---

## Step 3 — Subscribe

Tap **Subscribe** to confirm. Your device is now listening for alerts.

![Next](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c786c8e3c7f9fc98e8819f5bfd586d3f3e8852b5_0.webp)

---

## Step 4 — Connect in Minecraft

Join any world or server and run:

```
/nearme topic your-topic
```

> ⚠️ Replace `your-topic` with the exact topic name you created in ntfy.sh.

That's it — you'll now get a notification whenever a player enters your detection radius.

---

# ⚙️ Commands

| Command | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `/nearme topic <name>` | Set your ntfy notification topic | — |
| `/nearme radius <5–200>` | Detection radius in blocks | `30` |
| `/nearme cooldown <10–3600>` | Seconds between alerts | `60` |
| `/nearme toggle` | Enable or disable the mod | `enabled` |
| `/nearme status` | Show current settings | — |
| `/nearme test` | Send a test notification | — |
